finding: Bell2 and Stress4 place all work on one DPU even when three or four DPUs are allocated. The initial inspector incorrectly required full allocation utilization for every correctness case.

sdk_provenance_caveat.cause: CLI used dpu-pkg-config --version, which reports the pkg-config tool version.
sdk_provenance_caveat.correction: Use dpu-pkg-config --modversion dpu for new environment and preflight facts. Do not rewrite historical raw manifests.

correction.gate: Reconstruct exact plans, bind scientific identities, and compare active DPU IDs and counts with planned placements. Require full activity for Stress14 and exact planned partial activity for Bell2.

disposition: Retain as an auditable SDK coverage probe. Use a newly frozen corrected integration matrix and source for the next full gate. No physical performance claim or allocation-incident claim follows from this record.
